info.title: House Broker API
info.description: House Broker listing, image, lookup, and commission-rate endpoints. Errors are returned as RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with stable error codes.

get.description: Executes this endpoint according to the House Broker API contract.

post.description: Executes this endpoint according to the House Broker API contract.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key, 16 to 64 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore or dash. A replay returns the original response with Idempotent-Replayed: true.

201.description: Created. The Location header points at the rate's resource URI.

400.description: Bad request: validation failed or the Idempotency-Key format is invalid.

409.description: Conflict: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still in progress.

422.description: Unprocessable entity: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

put.description: Executes this endpoint according to the House Broker API contract.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required strong ETag (rowversion) for concurrency control. Returns 428 if missing and 412 if stale.

delete.summary: Retires a commission rate band (soft delete).
delete.description:
Sets `IsActive` to false; the row remains visible in `GET` but is ignored by pricing. Retiring the
active open-ended top band promotes the highest remaining active band to open-ended in the same transaction.

204.description: No content: the band was retired.

409.description: Conflict: retiring the band would leave the active set invalid.

412.description: Precondition failed: the If-Match version is stale.

post.summary: Reactivates a retired commission rate band.
post.description: The whole active set is re-validated before the band becomes active again.

200.description: OK: the band is active again.

400.description: Bad request: the stored set is invalid and the request does not fix it.

409.description: Conflict: reactivating the band would leave the active set invalid.

412.description: Precondition failed: the If-Match version is stale.

phoneNumber.description: Gets or sets the phone number.

minPrice.description:
Gets or sets the derived lower bound for display, or null when the band is not yet effective.
Retired bands keep their last derived lower bound. The lower bound is not stored; it comes from the
previous band in the full set.

minInclusive.description:
Gets or sets whether the derived lower bound is inclusive for display, or null when the band is retired or
not yet effective.

maxPrice.description: Gets or sets the upper bound, or null for the open-ended top band.

maxInclusive.description: Gets or sets whether the upper bound is inclusive.

ratePercent.description: Gets or sets the rate percent.

isActive.description: Gets or sets whether the band is active.

effectiveFrom.description: Gets or sets the effective-from timestamp.
